summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration-3 bug fixes on the single-page Primal Origins + Echo site. Verified: 7 real review card images render in the testimonials marquee (all 14 testids review-0..review-13 present, every image naturalWidth=1080, HTTP 200 for /reviews/1..7.png); Echo phone-frame image (alt 'Echo app login screen') loads (573x1235); coaching hero image loads (b&w woman-at-laptop, 5893x3934) and the gap between coaching-hero and #methodology is 0px with hero height 800px (no min-h-screen whitespace); navbar logo (h=80px desktop, 64px mobile) and footer logo (h=80px) both load; methodology image is the warm couch conversation. Global scan found 0 broken images (naturalWidth===0) across the whole page. Regressions all pass: all nav links (Coaching/Methodology/About/Echo/Contact targets) smooth-scroll to top offset ~0; claim-form submits name+email and shows claim-success ('You're in. ... Check your inbox — we've sent your personal invite link and referral code' + 'Spot reserved for <email>'); footer Terms dialog (2046 chars, contains 'Eligibility') and Privacy dialog (1590 chars, contains 'Data We Collect') open with real legal content. No horizontal overflow at 1920px or 390px. No console errors, no failed requests.

issues: Review cards are rendered at 300-340px wide from 1080x1350 source images containing dense paragraph text; the review copy is effectively unreadable at that scale (especially on mobile 390px). Consider wider cards, a click-to-enlarge lightbox, or extracting the text as real HTML.
Total page weight from reviews is heavy: the 7 PNGs are ~0.4-1.0 MB each (~5.8 MB total). Recommend converting to compressed WebP/JPEG (~100-150 KB each) for load performance.
Success copy says 'Check your inbox' rather than the literally-specified 'check your email' — semantically equivalent, flagged only for spec exactness, not a defect.

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): compress /app/frontend/public/reviews/*.png to WebP to cut ~5.8 MB of image payload.
Optional (non-blocking): improve legibility of review card images (larger cards or lightbox on click).
critical_code_review_comments: Testimonials.jsx uses loading="lazy" on marquee images; duplicated off-screen copies still loaded fine in this run, but with ~1MB PNGs the marquee can visibly pop-in on slow networks — preloading the first few or using eager loading for the first set would be safer.
content.js still exports the now-unused TESTIMONIALS array (unsplash avatars) after the switch to REVIEWS images — dead code, safe to remove.
seed_data_creation: Submitted one claim-form entry with name 'TEST QA User' / qa.test+iter3@example.com (Google Sheet webhook is mocked/empty as expected).
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in app; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iteration-3 bug fixes verified working: enlarged nav/footer logos, reverted hero + methodology images, Echo login-screen phone frame, 7 real review images in marquee, reduced hero spacing (gap to #methodology = 0px). Zero broken images site-wide. Remaining items are purely optional performance/legibility polish on the review card images. Backend endpoints were verified in iterations 1-2 and were not retested.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects reproduced this iteration; all previously reported image/spacing bugs are resolved.
